name: repairs_followup_notifications_constraints
preconditionSql: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.schema_migrations WHERE version = '0019') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'pk_repair_orders') AS ok;
verificationSql: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'pk_repair_orders' AND contype = 'p') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'uq_repair_orders__branch_document' AND contype = 'u') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'pk_followup_status_history' AND contype = 'p') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'uq_repair_customer_decisions__issue' AND contype = 'u') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'pk_notification_recipients' AND contype = 'p') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'fk_customer_followups__source_event' AND contype = 'f') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'fk_notifications__outbox_event' AND contype = 'f') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'ck_repair_orders__status' AND contype = 'c') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'ck_repair_customer_decisions__decision' AND contype = 'c') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'ck_customer_followups__source_type' AND contype = 'c') AND to_regclass('public.uq_repair_assignments__active') IS NOT NULL AND to_regclass('public.uq_customer_followups__source_event') IS NOT NULL AND to_regclass('public.uq_notifications__outbox_event_type') IS NOT NULL AS ok;
recovery: Transactional failure rolls the Repairs / Follow-Up / Notifications constraint migration back. After successful production apply, recovery is forward-only: preserve repair, follow-up and notification history and issue a reviewed corrective migration rather than dropping integrity constraints or rewriting committed migration history. The approved active-assignment, automatic-follow-up source-event and notification outbox-event/type partial unique indexes are integrity mechanisms owned by 03.06; non-integrity query/performance indexes remain Phase 03.07. Repair status commands, required issue/decision transaction effects, Follow-Up actions, permission checks, idempotency, Audit/Outbox and notification delivery remain later backend transaction responsibilities.
